prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Target source lambda gain is small at one token but positive at all ten, and separate isotropic Tc increases by 1.371 K. The effect mixes mass, orbital chemistry and charge redistribution; actual mobile n and orbital bandwidth are unknown. Tc availability/radioactivity is a follow-up cost risk only. All target forces zero, finite source q and Gamma evidence positive.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.002 GPa; fine force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure 0.036 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.
unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Re-to-Tc minority role replacement in Nb-Mo-Tc ordered SG225. coupled chemical/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare saved orbital/mode and Coulomb-sensitive source evidence for Re/Tc neighbors. Favorable: the fixed-phase response survives physically matched model checks; adverse: the small EPC change reverses and Tc benefit is solely assumed mu; ambiguous: only nominal electrons available.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
